g1.flow: Same words, fa man shāʾa dhakarah, both after 'No! Indeed, … a reminder'. Al-Muddaththir says 'it is a reminder' and follows with 'they will not remember except that Allāh wills'. ʿAbasa says 'they are a reminder' and follows with 'in honored sheets'. Hook: Al-Muddaththir moves to Allāh's will; ʿAbasa moves to the honored sheets.

cues.74:55: Al-Muddaththir: after 'it is a reminder'; next, none remember unless Allāh wills.
cues.80:12: ʿAbasa: after 'they are a reminder'; next, recorded in honored sheets.

g2.flow: Identical words, matāʿan lakum wa li-anʿāmikum, closing a list of provisions in both. An-Nāziʿāt: after the mountains set firmly; next, 'the greatest Overwhelming Calamity'. ʿAbasa: after fruit and grass; next, 'the Deafening Blast'. Hook: mountains lead to the Calamity; fruit and grass lead to the Blast.

cues.79:33: An-Nāziʿāt: after 'the mountains He set firmly'; next, the greatest Overwhelming Calamity.
cues.80:32: ʿAbasa: after 'fruit and grass'; next, the Deafening Blast.
